schluessel.nur-zaehler: This API key may only retrieve the numbers (GET /api/v1/ich/zaehler). For anything else you need a “read only” or “read and write” key.
schluessel.nur-zaehler-laufwerk: This API key may only retrieve the numbers and doesn’t open the drive. Use a “read only” or “read and write” key for that.
stufe.hilfe.lesen: Reads everything you may read, changes nothing.
stufe.hilfe.schreiben: Reads and changes everything you may.
stufe.hilfe.zaehler: For home automation and displays: the key only retrieves the numbers (new post, to do, upcoming and overdue deadlines). If it gets lost, someone learns at most how much post and how many tasks you have.
ausgang.herunterladen.eine: Downloading isn’t allowed for this folder. For that you need the export permission (E) in a view that shows it. You can still view the documents in Ablago.
ausgang.herunterladen.mehrere_one: You may not download one folder. For that you need the export permission (E) in a view that shows it.
ausgang.herunterladen.mehrere_other: You may not download {anzahl} folders. For that you need the export permission (E) in a view that shows them.
ausgang.email.eine: You may not send this folder. Like exporting, sending is only allowed from views where you have the permission for it.
ausgang.email.mehrere_one: You may not send one folder. Like exporting, sending is only allowed from views where you have the permission for it.
ausgang.email.mehrere_other: You may not send {anzahl} folders. Like exporting, sending is only allowed from views where you have the permission for it.
ausgang.export.eine: You may not export this folder. Exporting is only allowed from views where you have the permission for it.
ausgang.export.mehrere_one: You may not export any of these folders. Exporting is only allowed from views where you have the permission for it.
ausgang.export.mehrere_other: You may not export any of these folders. Exporting is only allowed from views where you have the permission for it.
ausgang.export.sicht: You may not export from this view.
ausgang.webdav.eine: Downloading isn’t allowed for this folder. For that you need the export permission in a view that shows it.
ausgang.webdav.mehrere_one: You may not download one folder via the drive.
ausgang.webdav.mehrere_other: You may not download {anzahl} folders via the drive.
webdav.nur-lesend: The drive is switched on for reading only. Filing, changing, renaming and deleting are done in Ablago itself.
webdav.pflicht: This tab is read-only via the drive: the folder type requires a stamp when passing documents on, and saving back would put it into a new version. Filing and changing are done in Ablago itself.
webdav.gestempelt: “{name}” comes out of the drive with a stamp and therefore can’t be overwritten here – otherwise the stamp would end up in a new version. Save the file under a new name or replace it in Ablago itself.
webdav.nicht-stempelbar: “{name}” can’t be stamped, but the folder type requires a stamp when passing documents on. View the file in Ablago.
webdav.stempel-ungueltig: stempel: ID of a stamp template or null (no stamp).
webdav.vorlage-fehlt: This stamp template doesn’t exist (any more).
webdav.vorlage-in-gebrauch: The template “{name}” stamps documents when they are read via the WebDAV drive. First choose another template or “No stamp” there.
